question: Top 5 quốc gia khách hàng có số khách hàng mua qua Internet cao nhất
gold_sql: SELECT g.english_country_region_name, count(DISTINCT f.customer_key) FROM fact_internet_sales f JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key JOIN dim_geography g ON g.geography_key = c.geography_key GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5
note: no period: every year of the warehouse; answered right on 24/11
